sections.title: Charged Attack

At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

abilities.name: Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost
_curatorNotes: Variants above are pre-existing display variants from the generator showing infusion duration (talent-scaling, 2.0–3.0s) and field duration (10s). Field entity lifetime is now canonical on summons[0]. Infusion duration (infuseDur[talentLevel]) is applied as a stat modifier on characters within the field on each tick — not a separate summon entity.

Field ticks every 60 frames from skillHitmark (frame 36) through expiry at frame 636 (skillHitmark + 600). Each tick checks if active character is within the field area and applies cryo infusion + A1 ATK SPD buff for infuseDur seconds. This is a proc mechanic, not a persistent aura — reviewer to decide effect representation.
abilities.description:
Chongyun strikes the ground with his greatsword, causing a Cryo explosion in a circular AoE in front of him that deals Cryo DMG.
After a short delay, the cold air created by the Cryo explosion will coalesce into a Chonghua Frost Field, within which all Sword, Claymore and Polearm-wielding characters' weapons will be infused with Cryo.

abilities.name: Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star
_curatorNotes: behavior changed from generator stub 'persistent' to 'instant': the 3 spirit blades are queued projectile hits (frames 50, 59, 67) — there is no persistent entity or stance window. C6 adds a 4th blade at frame 77. No summons[] needed.

ActionSwap not explicitly set in burstFrames (InitAbilSlice(79)) — stays at AnimationLength 79. swap key omitted per recipe rule. This means the burst cannot be swap-cancelled before the full 79-frame animation.
abilities.description:
Performing the secret hand seals, Chongyun summons 3 giant spirit blades in mid-air that fall to the earth one by one after a short delay, exploding as they hit the ground.
When the spirit blades explode, they will deal AoE Cryo DMG and launch opponents.

_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — A1 grants +8% Normal ATK SPD (AtkSpd stat mod) to sword/claymore/polearm characters within the Chonghua Frost Field. Applied per character on each field infusion tick for infuseDur duration (talent-scaling). Reviewer to author effect skeleton.
passives.description: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters within the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 8%.

passives.name: Rimechaser Blade

_curatorNotes: Migrated to afterDuration skill 2026-05-09 (F1). Fires once when Chonghua Frost Field expires, via c.a4() in skill.go. Cryo RES -10% for 8s (480 frames, asc.go a4CB modifier).

passives.description: When the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost disappears, another spirit blade will be summoned to strike nearby opponents, dealing 100% of Chonghua's Layered Frost's Skill DMG as AoE Cryo DMG. Opponents hit by this blade will have their Cryo RES decreased by 10% for 8s.

constellations.name: Ice Unleashed

_curatorNotes: Likely onHit trigger on N4 (NormalCounter==3, the last hit of the 4-hit combo) at constellation >= 1. Fires 3 blades in sequence at N4_hitmark+0, +5, +10 frames (frames 53, 58, 63 from cast start). Each blade deals 50% ATK as Cryo DMG to all opponents in its path. Scope: AoE (NewCircleHit). No ICD tag (ICDTagNone in gcsim cons.go).

constellations.description: The last attack of Chongyun's Normal Attack combo releases 3 ice blades. Each blade deals 50% of Chongyun's ATK as Cryo DMG to all opponents in its path.

constellations.name: Atmospheric Revolution
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — C2 reduces CD of E and Q by 15% when cast within the Chonghua Frost Field. Applied via CooldownMod on the active character on each infusion tick (skill.go infuse()). constellations.description: Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts cast within the Frost Field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their CD time decreased by 15%.

constellations.name: Frozen Skies

_curatorNotes: Likely onHit trigger: active character hits enemy with Cryo aura, 2s ICD (c4ICDKey in cons.go). Condition: Chongyun must be the active character (c.Core.Player.Active() == c.Index()), enemy must have Cryo aura (e.AuraContains(Cryo)), constellation >= 4. constellations.name: Rally of Four Blades
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — C6 has two effects: (1) Q deals 15% more DMG to enemies whose HP% is lower than Chongyun's HP% (conditional DmgP bonus, checked per-hit in cons.go c6()); (2) Q fires 1 additional spirit blade at frame 77 (burstHitmarkC6). The HP-comparison condition (enemy.HP/MaxHP < c.CurrentHPRatio()) requires runtime state and has no schema analog yet. Reviewer to author both effects.

This skill will also summon 1 additional spirit blade.
